summary: TSLA Q3 results after the 21 Oct close: revenue flat at ~$28.0B, net income -43% to $787M, gross margin 19.6%, FCF +$1.5B. Positives: FSD paid users 1.74M (+67%), Cybercab launch in Dallas next month, Optimus early production. Mixed print; mentions doubled vs prior days on earnings.
catalyst_note: Q3 earnings 21 Oct: mixed (flat revenue, lower profit, strong FSD/robotaxi updates)
